titleStmt.title: An dem frohen Geburhtsfeste der Fürstin und Frau Christine Sophie, Marggräfin zu Brandenburg-Culmbach, ward folgende Serenate aufgeführet

work.title: An dem frohen Geburhtsfeste der Fürstin und Frau Christine Sophie, Marggräfin zu Brandenburg-Culmbach, ward folgende Serenate aufgeführet

history.p: In 1739, Scheibe found employment as Kapellmeister at the court of Friedrich Ernst von Brandenburg-Kulmbach, the governor of Schleswig-Holstein and brother-in-law to the Danish king. One of the works which Scheibe composed while at the court of Friedrich Ernst is the present cantata or ‘Serenate’ celebrating the birthday of the margrave's wife, Christine Sophie of Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel-Bevern on 22 January 1740. Scheibe wrote the text himself. Shortly after the performance of the birthday cantata, Scheibe wrote a letter to his acquaintance Johann Christoph Gottsched in Leipzig and included the text to the work, mentioning that 'for the most part of this winter I have been in Gottorf, and I had to manage again my commitment as a poet and a composer at the same time. The first piece for the margrave’s birthday in particular was made in great haste, and I had barely three days' time for everything.' He also appended a poem written for the birthday of the son of Margrave Karl Alexander von Brandenburg-Ansbach – a work that Scheibe had also done in great haste. The following year, in February 1741, when Scheibe had moved to Copenhagen employed as Kapellmeister, he apparently once again composed music to a text he had written which was to be performed celebrating the birthday of Christine Sophie. Scheibe included the text in a letter to Gottsched: 'In addition, once again I have to write a sheet of verses for the margravine’s birthday.'

annot.p: 'Ich bin den meisten Theil dieses Winters in Gottorf gewesen, und muste wieder meinen Willen die Personen eines Dichters und eines Componistens zugleich verwalten. Das erste Stück auf den Geburthstag des Marggrafens ist insonderheit noch in gröster Eil verfertiget, und ich hatte zu allen kaum 3 Tage Zeit dazu.'

annot.p: 'Inzwischen kommt hierbeÿ abermal ein Bogen Verse, den ich auf den Geburthstag der Fr Marggräffin verfertiget müßen.'

incipText.p: Das schlechte Fabelwerk, womit Du dich erhebest
Dich / o Tugend! will ich fragen
Wahr ists, mein Ansehn ist zum Theil dahin
Und ich soll keinen Theil an eurer Freundschaft haben?
